flat_pitch.label: Pitch range
flat_pitch.risk: Pitch contour is unnaturally flat ({v:.2f} semitones of movement) - typical of neural TTS

low_jitter.label: Pitch micro-variation
low_jitter.risk: Near-zero cycle-to-cycle pitch wobble (jitter {v:.2f}%) - vocal folds are never this regular

high_periodicity.label: Harmonic purity
high_periodicity.risk: Harmonics are unnaturally clean ({v:.1f} dB) - little breath or turbulence noise
high_periodicity.ok: Breath and turbulence noise present ({v:.1f} dB)

hf_missing.label: Energy above 4 kHz
hf_missing.risk: Very little energy above 4 kHz ({v:.2f}%) - fricatives are under-rendered, vocoder-like

band_cliff.label: Synthetic band ceiling
band_cliff.risk: Hard band ceiling mid-spectrum ({v:.0f} dB step) - a generator/vocoder cut-off, not a microphone
band_cliff.ok: No artificial band cut-off ({v:.0f} dB step)

no_pauses.label: Breathing pauses
no_pauses.risk: Almost no natural pauses ({v:.0%} of the clip) - continuous, un-breathing delivery

weak_modulation.label: Syllabic rhythm
weak_modulation.risk: Weak 2-8 Hz syllabic rhythm ({v:.2f}) - the delivery is a continuous drone

flat_spectrum.label: Spectral flatness
flat_spectrum.risk: Noise-like flat spectrum ({v:.2f}) - consistent with a loudspeaker replay or heavy compression

noisy_channel.label: Channel noise
noisy_channel.risk: Loud background floor ({v:.0f} dBFS) - open-air capture or a replayed recording

clean_silence.label: Silence purity
clean_silence.risk: Silences are digitally clean ({v:.0f} dBFS) - no room or handset noise at all

speaker_mismatch.reason: Voice does not match the enrolled reference - escalated regardless of the spoof score, because a mismatch and a clone are both grounds to step up.

actions.red: BLOCK the request. Call back on the registered number and require a dynamic second factor (push-approve / FIDO). Never release funds or credentials on this call.
actions.amber: STEP UP before anything moves. Independent callback plus a dynamic second factor; treat caller ID as untrusted.
actions.green: PROCEED under your normal policy - voice is only a contextual signal, and the RBI-mandated dynamic second factor still applies.
